notes: All three `לְ`s are `unrepresented` under rule 40: the ASV apposes the list to the *kings* of v10 and spends no English word on any of the three relations.
The article of `הַבָּשָׁן` is `unrepresented` while that of `הָאֱמֹרִי` takes a written *the*, following rule 29's count of the determiners the ASV actually writes.
